# blockchainlab-labs

> 54 runnable smart-contract labs: 45 Solidity labs with Foundry tests (storage to reentrancy, AMMs, flash loans, proxies, ERC-7201, fuzzing, invariants, mainnet forks), 4 Noir ZK labs, 4 Cairo/Starknet labs and a Hardhat lab. Each lab is a small, tested, importable contract.

## Docs

- [README](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Blockchains/blockchainlab-labs/main/README.md): overview, install and the 'Use as a building block' section
- [AGENTS.md](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Blockchains/blockchainlab-labs/main/AGENTS.md): setup, build/test commands, structure map, conventions and rules for AI coding agents
- [blocks.json](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Blockchains/blockchainlab-labs/main/blocks.json): machine-readable building-block manifest (entrypoints, inputs, outputs, deps, compatible blocks)

## Key files

- [src/L21_ConstantProductAMM.sol](https://github.com/Blockchains/blockchainlab-labs/blob/main/src/L21_ConstantProductAMM.sol): AMM lab
- [src/L22_FlashLoan.sol](https://github.com/Blockchains/blockchainlab-labs/blob/main/src/L22_FlashLoan.sol): ERC-3156 flash loan lab
- [src/L24_NamespacedStorage.sol](https://github.com/Blockchains/blockchainlab-labs/blob/main/src/L24_NamespacedStorage.sol): ERC-7201 lab
- [foundry.toml](https://github.com/Blockchains/blockchainlab-labs/blob/main/foundry.toml): Foundry config
